record.one_liner: Copper is a CRM for contacts, companies, opportunities, pipelines and activities, with a REST Developer API for building custom integrations.
record.auth_notes: API keys are generated in the Copper web app under System settings > API Keys and sent as a token header with the token owner's email. OAuth2.0 is offered but requires registering the app with Copper first, and Copper describes it as the preferred approach for partner integrations.
record.access_notes: API keys are self-serve from the web app. The fetched docs and pricing page did not state whether API access needs a specific paid plan, so the free-plan classification is not confirmed. OAuth registration requires contacting Copper.
record.api_notes: Docs say the Dev API gives access to most Copper resources with read and write requests. Breadth is a judgement call based on that wording; object-level coverage was not checked endpoint by endpoint.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials and a documented REST API are available self-serve. Open item: the plan tier needed for API access is unconfirmed. The official Copper MCP server is announced as a beta launching November 2026 with a waitlist, so it is not yet usable.
